responses: Hi! I'm the Dorm Assistant. Ask me how anything in the Vacancy Tracker works, like rooms, reservations, checkouts or viewer access.
Hello! What would you like to know about the tracker?
Doing great, thanks! How can I help with the tracker today?
All good here. What do you need help with?
You're welcome!
Happy to help! Ask me anything else about the tracker.
Anytime!
Goodbye! Come back anytime.
See you later!
I'm the Dorm Assistant, a small chatbot trained on this Vacancy Tracker. I run on your own Firebase project with no outside AI service, so I only know about this website.

patterns: show me what you can do
responses: I can explain every part of the tracker: rooms and beds, bed colors, checkouts, extending stays, transfers, reservations, temporary clients, the hallway map, analytics, viewer access, central link and data transfer. I can also tell you your current vacant beds, occupancy and overdue tenants. I can't edit your records, but I'll show you the exact buttons to press.

patterns: what is the dorm vacancy tracker
responses: The Vacancy Tracker manages dormitory beds in real time. Use the three-line menu at the top left to open the tabs: Room Canvas, Checkout Reminders, Hallway Layout, Analytics, Bed Matrix, Checkout Schedule, Reserved Clients, Temporary Dorm Clients, Tenant History, Viewer Access, Central Link and Data Transfer. Everything updates live.

patterns: what is the difference between admin and viewer
responses: There are four roles. Branch Admin manages one dormitory (rooms, tenants, reservations). Super Admin connects many dormitories and sees their approved summaries and trends. Dormitory Viewer sees one dorm's vacancies using its code and password. Marketing Viewer browses the directory of all published dormitories. Viewers are read-only.

patterns: how do i get into the system
responses: On the welcome screen choose Admin, then Branch Admin, and sign in with Google or your email and password. If Google's popup is blocked, allow popups for the site and try again. If you see 'not authorized', the account is not on this workspace's allowed list, so ask your administrator.

patterns: how do i create an account
can i make my own account
responses: On the Branch Admin sign-in screen press Create account, enter your full name, email and a password of at least 6 characters, then press Create account. Each account gets its own private workspace.
On the sign-in screen type your email, then press Forgot password. A reset email will be sent. For a dorm viewer password, ask the Branch Admin to set a new one in the Viewer Access tab.

patterns: why do i have to sign in again
responses: Press Sign out at the top right. For safety the app only keeps you signed in for the current browser tab, so closing the tab signs you out and you will need to sign in again next time.

patterns: how do i turn on dark mode
responses: Press the moon or sun button at the top right of the page to switch between light and dark mode. Your choice is remembered in this browser.

patterns: how do i add a room
i want to add a room
how do i set up my rooms
how do i add rooms to the dorm
responses: Open Room Canvas (or Hallway Layout) and press + Add room. Enter the room number, type, gender, air conditioning, resident group zoning and tenancy mode, pick the capacity (1 to 20 beds), optionally fill in tenants, then press Save room. Room names must be unique.

patterns: how do i edit a room
how do i change gender of a room
update checkout date of a tenant
responses: Press the pencil icon on the room card, or Edit on a bed, change what you need and press Save room. You can rename the room, change gender, zoning, AC and capacity, and edit each bed's tenant, resident group, gender, check-in and checkout. To simply extend a stay, use the Extend button instead.

patterns: how do i delete a room
how to remove a room from the system
i want to delete a room
responses: Press the trash icon on the room card and confirm with Yes, Delete. A room can only be deleted when it has no residents, reservations or temporary clients, so check them out or cancel them first.

patterns: how do i remove a bed
take out a bed from a room
add another bed to a room
responses: To remove a bed, press Remove bed on a vacant bed (it only appears on beds with no tenant, reservation or temporary guest). A room needs at least one bed. To add beds, edit the room and choose a bigger capacity.

patterns: what is the difference between room and bedspacer
can i put males in a female room
why can't i assign a tenant to this room
who can stay in a student room
responses: Gender assignment (Male, Female or Mixed) limits who can be placed in the room. Resident group zoning (Students, Reviewees or Mixed) limits the kind of resident. Type is Room or Bedspacer, and AC marks air-conditioned rooms. Temporary guests ignore the zoning, and the app blocks any assignment that conflicts with a room's gender or zoning.

patterns: difference between bedspace and whole room
rent the whole room to one person
why is the whole room marked occupied
only one tenant allowed in room
responses: Bedspace mode lets each bed hold its own tenant. Whole Room mode rents the entire room to one resident or one reservation, so once one bed is taken the other beds count as unavailable and the room cannot hold more than one assigned resident.

patterns: what do the status colors mean
responses: Bed statuses: Vacant (green) is free. Occupied (blue) has a tenant. Reserved (purple) is held for an incoming client. Temporary occupied (brown) is a short-stay guest. Checkout 48h (amber) leaves within two days. Overdue (red) is past the checkout date and waits for you to extend or check out.

patterns: how do i add a tenant
how to check in a tenant
assign a tenant to a bed
how do i move someone into a room
how do i assign a bed
check in a new tenant now
responses: On a vacant bed press Check in (it opens the room editor). Type the tenant name, choose resident group and gender, set the check-in and checkout dates, then Save room. For someone arriving later, use Reserved Clients so the bed is held and checked in automatically.

patterns: how do i check out a tenant
how do i make a bed vacant
remove a tenant from a bed
tenant left what do i do
responses: Press Check out on the tenant's bed (also available in Checkout Reminders and Checkout Schedule) and confirm. The bed becomes vacant, any reserved client still keeps the bed, and the tenant's record stays in Tenant History for 30 days. Temporary guests are checked out from the Temporary Dorm Clients tab.

patterns: why is there a red badge
what to do with overdue tenants
what is the checkout reminders tab
tenant did not leave on time
tenant is still here after checkout date
resident has not moved out yet
responses: The Checkout Reminders tab lists tenants past their checkout date and shows a red count badge. Each bed stays Overdue until you press Extend (to set a later checkout) or Check out. It also shows who is reserved to arrive next on that bed.

patterns: how do i extend a stay
extend stay when someone has a reservation
responses: Press Extend on the tenant's bed, choose a new checkout date that is later than the current one, and save. If a client is reserved for that bed, you must tick the box to cancel that reservation first, and the client returns to Searching so you can pick another bed. Temporary stays cannot be extended here.

patterns: how do i transfer a tenant
move a tenant to another room
drag a tenant to another bed
how to move someone to a different room
how do i move a tenant
how to move a tenant to another bed
can i move someone to a different bed
how do i move a person to another room
responses: Press Move (or Transfer) on the tenant's bed, pick a compatible vacant bed in another room and confirm. You can also drag a tenant card onto a vacant bed. Dates and details are kept. Only beds that match the resident's gender and group are offered, and a bed with a future reservation cannot be moved.

patterns: how do i reserve a bed
how to add a reserved client
reserve a bed for someone arriving later
how do i reserve a room
reserve for a future check in
how do i use the reservation wizard
reserve a bed that is still occupied
responses: Open Reserved Clients and press + Add reserve client. Choose Single or Group, enter the name(s), gender, resident group, check-in (and optional check-out), then the app scans free beds and beds whose tenant leaves in time. Pick one and confirm. If the current tenant leaves after the arrival date, the app warns you first.

patterns: how do i reserve for a group
book for a group of students
how many members can a group have
reserve a whole group in one room
responses: In the Add reserve client pop-up choose Group, enter how many members (2 to 12) and their names. The scan then only shows rooms that have enough fitting beds for everyone, so the group can stay in the same room.

patterns: how do i cancel a reservation
how to free a reserved bed
responses: In Reserved Clients press Undo on the client's card to release the bed and put them back to Searching, or press the trash icon to delete the reservation entirely. Once a client is checked in the reservation cannot be undone.

patterns: does the reservation check in automatically
when does a reserved client move in
what happens on the check in date
why did the reserved client disappear
does the system move reserved clients by itself
responses: Yes. When the client's check-in time arrives and the bed is free, the app checks them in automatically, turns the bed to Occupied and removes them from the Reserved list. If the previous tenant is still there, the check-in waits until that tenant's checkout passes.

patterns: how do i add a temporary client
how to place a temporary guest
how does the temporary flow work
responses: Temporary Dorm Clients are guests placed in any free bed (only gender matters) while they wait for a permanent bed. Press + Add temporary client, choose Single or Group, enter details, pick the temporary room, then pick the permanent room they will move to. The temporary checkout date is set to when that permanent bed becomes free.

patterns: why is the temporary tab red
what happens when temporary stay ends
responses: When a temporary guest's checkout is reached, the Temporary Dorm Clients tab turns red and asks 'Has the tenant already transferred?'. Choose Yes to check them out of the temporary bed, or Not yet and the reminder returns after 24 hours.

patterns: where did the checked out tenant go
responses: The Tenant History tab lists tenants who were checked out, removed or replaced, with their room, stay dates and what happened. Records are deleted automatically after 30 days, and the table shows how many days each one has left.

patterns: how do i move rooms on the map
how do i unlock the layout
how to edit the hallway map
why can't i drag the rooms
how do i rearrange the layout
move rooms on the floor plan
can i change room positions on the map
responses: Hallway Layout is a floor map of your rooms with a dot for each bed. It starts locked to prevent accidents. Press Layout locked to unlock it, then drag rooms to reposition them. Lock it again when you're done. Viewers see the same map without any names.

patterns: how do i add a facility
add a cr or lobby to the map
responses: Unlock Hallway Layout and press + Add Facility / Shape. Enter a label (like CR or Lobby), choose Facility or Corridor, rectangle, circle or triangle, and a color. Click a shape to select it, then use the handles to resize, and the small toolbar to rotate the text, edit or delete it.

patterns: see all tenants in a table
where can i see all contract dates
show all beds in one table
responses: Bed Matrix is a table with one row per bed: room, bed, gender, tenant, contract start and end, status, AC and quick actions like Edit or Move. It respects the filters at the top of the page.

patterns: what does the analytics page show
responses: Analytics shows a donut chart of bed occupancy (vacant, occupied, overdue, reserved) and a list of each room's capacity and vacancy with progress bars. It follows the shared filters at the top.

patterns: how do i use the carousel
how to find a checkout date
can i see who is leaving next week
responses: Checkout Schedule shows departures by month in a swipeable 3D carousel. Drag, use the arrows or the left and right keys to change months, Jump to Active goes to the nearest upcoming checkout, and Calendar lets you pick a date. Filters: Near is overdue or 0 to 3 days, Moderate is 4 to 10 days, Far is 11 days or more. Each card has Edit, Extend, Check out and Inspect.

patterns: how do i search for a tenant
how do i find a vacant bed
responses: The filter bar at the top of every tab lets you filter by gender, status (vacant, occupied, overdue, reserved, temporary, full rooms) and resident group, and search by room, bed or tenant name. The same filters apply to Room Canvas, Hallway Layout, Bed Matrix, Analytics, Checkout Schedule and Reserved Clients.

patterns: what are the numbers at the top
what do the top boxes show
what counts as occupied in the stats
responses: The boxes at the top show total rooms, bed capacity, vacant beds, occupied beds, overdue beds and the occupancy percentage. Occupied includes regular tenants, checkout-soon and temporary guests, and overdue tenants still count as occupying a bed until you check them out.

patterns: how do i set up viewer access
how do i give someone access to see rooms
how to share vacancies without names
how do i make a viewer link
how do i give viewers access
how can people see my vacancies
how do i share my dorm with viewers
responses: Open the Viewer Access tab, enter an optional dorm name, choose a dorm code (4 to 30 letters, numbers or dashes) and a password of 8+ characters, then press Turn on viewer access. Give viewers the viewer page link, the code and the password. They only see rooms, counts and the hallway map, never names or dates.

patterns: how do i block a viewer
how to change dorm password for viewers
how do i reset the dorm code password
how do i stop viewers from seeing the dorm
responses: In Viewer Access you can Copy link, Pause access, Change password (this removes everyone, who must rejoin with the new one), Turn off and delete, see everyone who joined, and Block or Unblock them. If your dorm is linked to a Super Admin, changing the password or deleting the server needs their approval first.

patterns: how do i view vacancies as a viewer
i am a viewer how do i join
where do i enter the dorm code
i don't know the dorm password
how do i see room availability
responses: Open the viewer page, sign in with Google or email, then enter the dorm code and password your administrator gave you. You'll see Vacancies, Hallway layout and Analytics. If you see 'Access ended', the administrator paused access or removed you. Use Switch server to enter another dorm's code.

patterns: how do i connect to a super admin
what data does the super admin see
how do i link my dorm
does the super admin see tenant names
responses: In the Central Link tab enter your dormitory name and city, press Generate pairing code and give the short-lived code to the Super Admin. They send a request, and you approve or reject Directory access and Analytics access separately. You can revoke or disconnect anytime. Only counts are shared, never resident names.

patterns: how do i transfer my data to another account
hand over the dorm to a new admin
move all data to a new account
what is moved in a data transfer
responses: In Data Transfer, the old admin writes the purpose and presses Generate transfer code (valid about a day). The new admin, using an empty account, enters it under Receive data, and the old admin approves. Rooms, reservations, temporary clients, history and layout move over and the old account is left empty. Viewer access and the Super Admin link are not moved, so set them up again.

patterns: what is import my existing rooms
responses: Import my existing rooms loads the sample data from seed-data.js, and it only appears when you run the project from your own computer, not on the live site, because the file contains real names. On the live site, add rooms with + Add room.

patterns: does the super admin see names
can other admins see my rooms
responses: Your rooms and tenants live in your own private workspace that only your account can read. Viewers and Super Admins only receive name-free counts, and only after you enable it. Dorm passwords are never stored, only a one-way fingerprint.

patterns: why did the page change by itself
can two people use it at once
responses: Yes, data syncs live, so no refresh is needed, and the time-based statuses refresh every minute. Viewers see changes while an admin has the app open. If nobody has it open, they see the last published state.

patterns: why can't i save the room
room changed while the editor was open
i get an error when adding a room
why is my room not saving
responses: Common reasons a room won't save: the room name already exists, a checkout is not later than its check-in, the gender or zoning conflicts with a tenant already in a bed, or the room was changed elsewhere while you had it open (close and reopen it). The message under the field tells you which one.

patterns: why can't i change this bed
a bed with a reservation cannot be changed
why can't i edit a temporary client
why is the extend button not showing
responses: Some actions are locked on purpose. Beds with a confirmed reservation can't be edited until you Undo it. Temporary guests must be checked out from their own tab. Capacity can't go below beds that hold residents or reservations, and rooms with residents can't be deleted.

patterns: how do i become a super admin
how do i see all dormitories
how do i connect a dormitory as super admin
what is the super admin server
how do i find a dorm with vacancies
responses: A Super Admin signs in from Admin, Super Admin, activates their account, and connects dorms using each Branch Admin's pairing code. After the branch approves, they see live vacancy cards, trend charts with forecasts and an inbox. Marketing Viewers use a Super Admin's server code and password to browse the directory of published dorms.

responses: Here are your current vacancies.

responses: Here are the tenants past their checkout.

responses: Here is your current occupancy.

responses: I can't change your records. I explain how and read your current counts. Tell me what you want to do, like add a room, extend a stay or reserve a bed, and I'll give you the exact steps.

patterns: who do i contact for help
responses: For bugs or account problems, contact your dormitory administrator or the developer who set up this tracker, and describe what you pressed and the message you saw. I can help with how-to questions.
